summary: Switched the worktree to a new branch feature/call-and-wait-tool off origin/main (fast-forwarded local main to match). Then explored the gizmo repo to draft a plan for a timeout-free background execution tool family (call/wait/check/list/cancel), modeled on existing run_script, workflows(background:true), and subagents spawn/wait patterns, with deferred follow-up notification via pi.sendMessage deliverAs 'followUp'.
decisions: Branch name chosen via interactive input: feature/call-and-wait-tool.
Local main was reset --hard to origin/main and reattached to track origin/main (was 1 behind at cedef7e).
New tool proposed as a family (call/wait/check/list/cancel) rather than a flag on run_script, to mirror subagents and avoid changing run_script semantics.
call should spawn Bun via child_process.spawn with shell:false and no timeout (not execFile), keeping run_script's path/ext/args guards.
Background runs should survive parent turn abort/Esc via an internal AbortController (like workflows RunController); cancel kills explicitly.

Notify on settle via deferred follow-up (customType 'call-result', deliverAs:'followUp', triggerTurn:true), flushed on agent_settled; wait consumes the deferred entry to prevent double-post, like subagent_wait.
Cap concurrent background calls at 4, output at ~20k chars with truncated flag, sweep idle finished after ~24h, kill on workspace removal / session shutdown.
Open questions deferred: log directory (agent dir vs workspace .gizmo/calls/), tool naming (call/wait vs run_script_background), and whether to survive server restart.
errors: display tool call failed with 'spec: must not have additional properties' on first attempt; retry succeeded after restructuring the spec.
